governance: THE CANONICAL RIGHTS RECORDS. One record per organisation, each carrying the Atlas Image Permission Outreach id it reflects. This file is the INPUT; image-rights-manifest.json is generated from it by .github/scripts/generate_image_rights_manifest.py and must not be hand-edited. Recording a grant or a withdrawal means editing a record here, regenerating, and committing both in the same act.
how_to_add_a_supplier: 1. Record the permission in Atlas (Image Permission Outreach) first; that is the source of record. 2. Add a record here carrying its record id and ref. 3. permission_outcome must be one of the gate's live-grant or known-non-grant values, spelled exactly. 4. permitted_domain is the supplier's own site. 5. If their site serves images from a third-party CDN, add permitted_delivery_hosts with the host AND a path prefix narrow enough to be theirs alone -- a host without a prefix is refused. 6. required_credit if the grant is conditional on one. 7. Regenerate. 8. Run the gate.

bothan_attribution.attribution: Designed by INTUMODULAR. Manufactured with Yard Box.
bothan_attribution.basis: Current first-party INTUMODULAR product page, https://www.intumodular.co.uk/the-bothan, read in a rendered browser 29 September 2026. It states verbatim: "Designed by INTUMODULAR. Manufactured with YardBox." and "BOTHAN is developed by INTUMODULAR in partnership with YardBox, combining design-led modular architecture with recognised manufacturing expertise." It also states "YardBox brings proven experience in precision-built modular structures."
bothan_attribution.conflicting_evidence: Cormac Carville, Yard Box, by email 29 September 2026 (thread 1a0d05e09446b7fe, message 1a0ed8a508425026): "Credit design and Manufacture to Yardbox." Yard Box's own models page also calls Bothán "our premium 45sqm modular home". RETAINED, NOT DELETED. It is the less specific statement and is not a published product attribution for the Bothán, so it does not overwrite the INTUMODULAR product page without further evidence.
bothan_attribution.imagery_effect: The attribution hold no longer excludes Bothán imagery. Any Bothán image must still pass the ordinary ownership, permission and delivery-host checks on its own merits — the lifted hold grants nothing.
bothan_attribution.do_not_import: Only the published attribution sentence and the partnership statement are evidenced. Broader characterisations — 'technical architecture and procurement brain', 'master manufacturer', or any split of individual design responsibilities — are NOT evidenced and must not be stated.
bothan_attribution.footprint: Cormac's correction stands and is unaffected: the Bothán 45 m² figure is the INTERNAL footprint. INTUMODULAR's page publishes 45 sqm without stating a measurement basis, so it neither confirms nor contradicts this.
bothan_attribution.contact: Cormac is NOT to be contacted about this. Founder direction, 29 September 2026: resolved from first-party published evidence.
